message.content: 字体子集化失败。我来寻找一个更小的 CJK 字体代替。

function.name: exec
function.arguments: {"command":"fc-list :lang=zh file | sort -u | head; ls -la /usr/share/fonts/truetype/wqy/ 2>/dev/null; find /usr/share/fonts -name '*.ttf' -size -5M | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo {} $(stat -c%s {})' | sort -k2 -n | tail -8"}
